profile_text.body:
Writesonic is a San Francisco, California-based software company that describes itself as "The AI Search Growth Engine," offering a platform focused on generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility. The company's site states the platform tracks visibility across 10 AI platforms and more than 50 markets, drawing on what it describes as a dataset of 2 billion or more real AI conversations updated weekly. Writesonic describes its customers as including Amazon, Unilever, Acer, and NP Digital.

The platform is presented as running a full cycle the company calls the AI Search Loop: identifying where a brand lacks visibility in AI-generated responses, executing fixes through content rewrites, citation outreach, and technical audits, and then measuring results at Day 14 and Day 28 intervals across citation share, AI traffic, conversions, and pipeline. Specific features described on the site include an AI agent that rewrites pages to add FAQ blocks and comparison tables, tooling to surface third-party sources such as Reddit threads and YouTube videos that cite competitors, and technical audits covering robots.txt, schema, indexing, and crawler errors from bots including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot. The site also describes agency-facing white-label reporting and a product-tracking module aimed at placing products into ChatGPT Shopping recommendations.

The held facts list WriteSonic in the Writing and Editing product category, noting marketing copy as its use case. The site's law exposure data associates Writesonic with 161 entries in California, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the held facts.
